scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,server -c yellow,blue "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.dev:sites: concurrently -n fn,web -c blue,yellow "node --env-file=server/.env dev/function-local-node.mjs" "npm run dev -w web -- --mode sites"
scripts.test: npm test -w web && npm test -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
